verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on late_share.

evidence: 100% of late trains were already late at 6 Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Lorimer St: 100, at or before 14 St-Union Sq: 4, at Bedford Av: 4, at 1 Av: 2. Largest time loss on segment 6 Av -> target (median +90s vs schedule).
93% of headway gaps at the target already existed at 6 Av.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 45% of delays on line(s) L (1.4x the system share) in the analysed months.
4% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 2.0x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 37% of delays on line(s) L (1.2x the system share) in the analysed months.
14% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'rolling_stock' alert was active for the line (problem rate 43% with an alert vs 26% without, lift 1.6x).
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 106s on average vs 58s otherwise (1.8x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
6% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'person_on_track' alert was active for the line (problem rate 43% with an alert vs 26% without, lift 1.6x).
4% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'obstruction' alert was active for the line (problem rate 43% with an alert vs 26% without, lift 1.6x).
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 10% of delays on line(s) L (0.5x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Review car-class reliability for L; pull chronic door/brake defects from peak assignments
recommendations.rationale: Mechanical alerts correlate with problem arrivals.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer disabled trains blocking the line.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for L; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Prioritise infrastructure & equipment work orders on the L corridor near 8 Av
recommendations.rationale: Infrastructure categories over-index in MTA-reported delays for the line.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for L; add supplement trains or move work windows off 17:00-18:00, 18:00-19:00, 19:00-20:00, 21:00-22:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Stage a spare train set near Canarsie-Rockaway Pkwy during 17:00-18:00, 18:00-19:00, 19:00-20:00, 21:00-22:00
recommendations.rationale: A ready spare turns a 20-minute gap into a 5-minute one.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the size of mechanical-caused gaps.

recommendations.action: Set a gap-filling rule: dispatch the next available train from Canarsie-Rockaway Pkwy when a gap over 6 min forms
recommendations.rationale: A fifth of arrivals follow a large gap.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the longest waits, which dominate the APT metric.

recommendations.action: Review dispatcher holding practice upstream of 8 Av; consider publishing hold reasons in the feed
recommendations.rationale: ETAs drift substantially before problem arrivals, indicating holds.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer discretionary holds; more accurate countdown clocks.
